label: Pathfinder 2e
tldr: Pathfinder 2e — mathematically tight fantasy. Three actions per turn, always d20s with explicit +/− modifiers, and a famous ladder where a 1 is a fumble and a 20 a crit (double damage/effect). Ancestry + background + class; classes grant Feats every 2 levels, and the class skill matters more than any other. Condition stacking (flanked, stunned, prone…) drives tactics.

links.data_api: no public data API — local profile only

races.Human: Versatile and tenacious, humans spread across Golarion faster than any other people, adapting to every land they claim.
races.Elf: Long-lived folk of fading forests and arcane grace. Elves remember centuries most others have forgotten.
races.Dwarf: Mountain-born craftsmen bound by clan and oath. A dwarf's word is a promise carved in stone.
races.Halfling: Small, cheerful, and quietly fearless. Halflings wander the world with a knack for luck and a talent for not being noticed.
races.Gnome: Endlessly curious souls who fade if they stop seeking wonder. Gnomes chase color, music, and novelty with infectious energy.
races.Orc: Strength and endurance forged by hardship. Orcs carry the weight of a harsh past and turn it into unbreakable resolve.
races.Goblin: Chaos with a heartbeat. Goblins burn bright and loud, devouring life — and occasionally their own inventions.
races.Leshy: Plant-bodied spirits given form by a druid's hand. Each leshy is grown for a purpose and shaped by the seasons.
races.Tengu: Crowlike wanderers and collectors. Tengu flock together, hoarding stories, steel, and secrets in equal measure.
races.Catfolk: Graceful amurrun traders and travelers, curious by nature and quick on every surface, nine lives not guaranteed.

classes.Alchemist: A brewer of bombs, elixirs, and happy accidents. Alchemists turn the periodic table into a battle plan.
classes.Barbarian: Fury is their heritage and their weapon. A barbarian's rage transforms pain into devastating power.
classes.Bard: A silver-tongued artist whose magic lives in performance. Bards inspire allies and disarm enemies with a verse.
classes.Champion: A holy bulwark sworn to a cause. Champions stand between the innocent and the darkness, shield raised.
classes.Cleric: A vessel of divine will. Clerics call down their deity's power as healing mercy or radiant judgment.
classes.Druid: A steward of the primal world. Druids command the elements, the wilds, and the very shape of their own body.
classes.Fighter: Mastery of combat above all else. fighters turn every battlefield into an expression of disciplined skill.
classes.Gunslinger: A dead-eye whose every shot tells a story. Gunslingers gamble on powder, timing, and one perfect moment.
classes.Inventor: A genius with a devoted, half-mad device at their side. Inventors build impossible machines and overclock them.
classes.Investigator: A deductive mind that sees patterns others miss. Investigators out-think danger before the first blow lands.
classes.Kineticist: A living conduit of elemental power. Kineticists channel fire, water, earth, air, or wood as an extension of self.
classes.Magus: Sword in one hand, spell in the other. Magi fuse steel and sorcery into a single devastating strike.
classes.Monk: A disciplined artist of unarmed combat. Monks perfect the body into a weapon and the mind into armor.
classes.Oracle: A martyr cursed with divine power. Oracles know the future and pay for it with a burden no prayer can lift.
classes.Psychic: A mind whose thoughts reshape reality. Psychics manifest raw mental power as bolts, shields, and subtle control.
classes.Ranger: A hunter attuned to the wild and the hunt. Rangers track, trap, and strike where the enemy least expects.
classes.Rogue: A shadow with a hundred tricks. Rogues slip past every lock and guard, then strike where it truly hurts.
classes.Sorcerer: Magic burns in their bloodline. Sorcerers shape inherited power by instinct rather than study.
classes.Summoner: Bound by spirit to an eidolon. Summoners and their otherworldly partner fight as one perfect, synced whole.
classes.Swashbuckler: Duelist, braggart, and whirlwind of style. Swashbucklers turn panache into punctuation and every duel into a story.
classes.Thaumaturge: A collector of relics and true names. Thaumaturges wield symbol and story to wound the strange and esoteric.
classes.Witch: Patron-bound keeper of hexes and familiars. Witches bargain with mysterious powers and whisper their curses to the world.
classes.Wizard: The scholar supreme. Wizards master reality through discipline, study, and an ever-growing spellbook.
